name: record_user_outcome
description: Persist an outcome event for a job (applied / replied / interviewing / offer / rejected / withdrawn). Append-only JSON Lines to data/user_outcomes.jsonl. The cost-saving doctrine uses these events as the primary measurement substrate for partner-pilot evidence (08-cost-saving-doctrine.md §1, §2, §8).

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Omit to use server-side now().
